about.label: About Us
about.title: About DEXOREN
about.desc: Since 2002 — from a trusted manufacturer to a one-stop home & general merchandise supply chain. 8,000㎡ wholesale showroom, integrated warehouse, 30,000+ SKUs covering kitchen, cleaning, storage, textiles, décor, pet and more.
about.storyP1: Founded in 2002, DEXOREN is a comprehensive manufacturer integrating R&D, manufacturing, and global distribution across five core product lines. Headquartered in Guangzhou, we operate an 80,000 m² modern production facility.
about.storyP2: Our CNAS-accredited laboratory houses world-class testing equipment and R&D instrumentation, supported by 20+ national patents. Our product portfolio spans furniture, building adhesives & sealants, LED lighting, construction hardware, and industrial cleaning solutions.
about.storyP3: For over two decades, DEXOREN has been driven by technological innovation and defined by product quality — delivering reliable, factory-direct products to 3,200+ clients worldwide.
about.journeyDesc: Over two decades of relentless progress — every step has been purposeful and resolute.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Common questions about products, ordering, and logistics
faq.q1: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faq.a1: MOQ varies by product. Most items start from 10 units per design. Contact us for specific product MOQ details — we can accommodate trial orders.
faq.a2: Yes. We provide full OEM/ODM services including custom dimensions, materials, colors, finishes, and branding. Our engineering team works with your specifications.
faq.q3: What is the typical lead time?
faq.a3: Standard lead time is 25-35 days for most products. Custom orders may take 35-45 days. Rush orders available upon request.
faq.q4: Can I get samples before bulk order?
faq.a4: Yes, samples are available. Sample cost is refundable with your first bulk order. We ship via DHL/FedEx/UPS with tracking.
faq.q5: What payment terms do you accept?
faq.a5: We accept T/T bank transfer and L/C at sight. Trade Assurance / escrow is available for first-time buyers, and PayPal or Western Union for samples and small amounts. Deposit and balance terms are agreed per order.
faq.q6: Do you provide logistics and shipping support?
faq.a6: Yes. We have partnerships with major freight forwarders and can arrange FOB/CIF/DDP shipping worldwide. Container optimization included.

certifications.heroSubtitle: All certificates are factory-original and available for per-country download upon request. We help you clear customs and meet local regulatory requirements worldwide.
certifications.introDesc: Every DEXOREN product is backed by internationally recognized certifications — so your shipments clear customs smoothly and your buyers trust what's on the shelf.
certifications.requestTitle: Need Certificate Files for Your Market?
certifications.requestDesc: We provide original, per-country certificate copies (PDF) and third-party test reports (SGS, TÜV, Intertek) to support your import clearance and tenders.
certifications.downloadNote: Certificates are issued per order and destination country. Tell us your target market and we'll send the exact documentation set you need.

tradeTerms.heroSubtitle: Transparent, flexible and export-ready. From Incoterms to payment and delivery, everything is designed to make cross-border sourcing simple and low-risk.
tradeTerms.incotermsSub: Choose the delivery term that fits your logistics setup. Most orders ship FOB or CIF from major Chinese ports.
tradeTerms.paymentsSub: Flexible, secure options for orders of every size — from a single sample to a full container.
tradeTerms.logisticsSub: We partner with major carriers and run overseas warehouses so your goods arrive on time, anywhere.
tradeTerms.moqDesc: In-stock items: from 10 pcs per SKU / design. OEM & private label: 500–1,000 pcs per SKU. Mixed SKUs can be consolidated into one container to lower your per-unit cost.
tradeTerms.leadTimeDesc: Standard products: 25–35 days. Custom/OEM orders: 35–45 days. Rush production available on request.
tradeTerms.sampleDesc: Samples are available and ship via DHL/FedEx/UPS with tracking. Sample cost is refundable against your first bulk order.
tradeTerms.packagingDesc: Standard export cartons with cushioning; custom color boxes, barcodes and palletization available. Wooden pallets and crates are ISPM-15 fumigated with official marking on request.
tradeTerms.ctaDesc: Tell us your target market, products and quantities — we'll propose the best Incoterm, payment plan and shipping route.
tradeTerms.complianceSub: How we protect your quality, your money and your market access — before, during and after shipment.
tradeTerms.qualityDesc: Pre-shipment inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas or Intertek is welcome — you appoint the inspector, or we arrange one. If the defect rate exceeds the agreed AQL, we re-make or credit the affected units.
tradeTerms.claimsDesc: Report shortage, damage or wrong shipment within 7 days of arrival with photo or video evidence. We settle valid claims by replacement, credit against your next order, or refund — agreed case by case.
tradeTerms.certDesc: We support destination-market conformity: SASO (Saudi Arabia), ESMA (UAE), PVOC (Kenya), SONCAP (Nigeria) and COC pre-shipment inspection, plus FDA / LFGB / EU 1935/2004 for food-contact items. Cost and lead time quoted per product.
tradeTerms.oemDesc: Custom logo, colour, packaging and barcodes from 500–1,000 pcs per SKU. We handle artwork, tooling and export carton design, with sample approval before mass production.
tradeTerms.quoteDesc: Quotes are issued in USD (CNY available on request) and remain valid for 30 days. Deposit and balance terms are agreed per order.
